response.sql:
WITH patient_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(CAST(HGB AS REAL) / HCT) as avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
cross_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM patient_avg_ratios
),
selected_patients AS (
  SELECT par.ID, par.avg_ratio
  FROM patient_avg_ratios par
  CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca
  WHERE par.avg_ratio > ca.overall_avg
),
patient_pics AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.ID,
    sp.avg_ratio,
    AVG(l.PIC) as avg_pic
  FROM selected_patients sp
  JOIN Laboratory l ON sp.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.PIC IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sp.ID, sp.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pp.avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio) as mean_ratios,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio - (SELECT overall_avg FROM cross_avg)) as mean_exceedance
FROM patient_pics pp;

assumptions.assumption: "Average across all patients" is computed as the mean of each patient's average HGB/HCT ratio (equal weight per patient), not as the mean across all individual records weighted by frequency.
Selected patients must have at least one non-NULL PIC record to contribute to the final summary row. Patients with HGB/HCT ratios above the threshold but no PIC data are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: "Average across all patients" means the mean HGB/HCT ratio computed from all individual lab records (weighting patients by their number of records). Patients whose average ratio exceeds this record-level average are selected.

WITH record_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    CAST(HGB AS REAL) / HCT as ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
),
record_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM record_ratios
),
patient_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM record_ratios
  GROUP BY ID
),
selected_patients AS (
  SELECT par.ID, par.avg_ratio
  FROM patient_avg_ratios par
  CROSS JOIN record_avg ra
  WHERE par.avg_ratio > ra.overall_avg
),
patient_pics AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.ID,
    sp.avg_ratio,
    AVG(l.PIC) as avg_pic
  FROM selected_patients sp
  JOIN Laboratory l ON sp.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.PIC IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sp.ID, sp.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pp.avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio) as mean_ratios,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio - (SELECT overall_avg FROM record_avg)) as mean_exceedance
FROM patient_pics pp;
